activity_statements.statement: designs, manufactures, and sells consumer electronics including iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, and AirPods to individual and business consumers worldwide

operates a digital services subscription business including Apple TV+ (original streaming video), Apple Music (audio streaming), Apple Arcade (mobile games), Apple Fitness+, and Apple News+ for end consumers
develops and licenses iOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS operating systems that power its hardware product lines
operates Apple Store retail locations and an online store with two-hour delivery, Personal Setup specialist sessions, and Guided Shopping for direct-to-consumer sales
offers Apple Card (consumer credit card), Apple Pay (mobile payments), Apple Trade In, and Apple Upgrade (device leasing program) as financial services for consumers
designs custom silicon (Apple-branded chips) for its own hardware to optimize performance and AI inference on device
operates iCloud storage and sync platform enabling cross-device data continuity for consumers across Apple hardware
sells Mac computers (MacBook Neo, MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iMac, Mac mini, Mac Studio) to education, creative professional, and consumer segments with education pricing programs

name_reality_gap: The name correctly signals a technology company, but the index label 'Computers and Electronics Manufacturing' understates that Apple is now heavily a services and software company — Services is its fastest-growing and highest-margin segment, encompassing streaming, gaming, payments, and app distribution.
